svg.title: Route and Ping on the communicator, mockups
svg.text: Route and Ping · communicator
T-LoRa Pager, 480×222, drawn at 2×. Turn moves, press selects, Backspace goes back.
Route
The Route row opens the path the next message to this peer takes, as a list from this device to the peer. Each repeater is a row the wheel stops on.
1 · Peer, Route focused
Route gains a chevron and opens the Route screen. Ping does the same for the Ping screen and no longer shows the last round
trip in its row. The value is the route in use, not the last frame heard.
2 · Route, source route
Turn moves from repeater to repeater, then into the rows below. You and the peer are not stops. A route records which repeaters
it crosses, not how each hop was heard, so the hops carry no readings.
3 · Route, asking a repeater
Turned to the end. A hint no known node matches shows the search glyph; press asks who it is, steered down the hops before it,
and the dots spin as in Details. The answer names it in place.
4 · Route, twelve hops
A long path is just a longer list; the last row is clipped to show it goes on.
5 · A repeater, opened
Pressing a known repeater opens the same screen a repeater opens from a message's Details. Backspace returns to the route,
focus where it was.
6 · Route, direct
One hop, and this device heard it, so it has a reading. No stops on the path: the wheel starts in the rows.
7 · Route, flood
A flood route counts its repeaters but cannot name them, so they are one dashed span.
8 · Route, nothing learned
No route yet, so the next message floods. Ping, the quickest way to learn one, is the only row.
Ping
Ping is its own screen. Opening it sends at once; Backspace leaves, and a reply that lands later still counts.
9 · Ping, waiting
The time counts up beside the spinner. A ping floods, so there is no path to draw until one comes back: only that it has left.
10 · Ping, reply
Round trip and hops, then Ping again, where the wheel starts. Turning down walks the path the reply took, in the Route screen's
list. A ping is traced with signal, so here each hop carries its reading, as the node nearer this device heard it. Earlier lists this
visit's pings.
11 · Ping, no reply
Nothing came back. Ping again is focused, so a press retries.
